audit.interpretation: Read-only audit after solving, using one empty-prefix scripted representative for every eligible legal joint action in sampled retained states. Every predicted result is checked against a fresh engine run; all chance labels, weights and choices must match. This is reuse potential for this sampled workload, not measured search speedup or a complete-kernel audit.

interpretation: The certified search itself is unchanged. The postsolve audit samples retained states deterministically and checks one empty-prefix scripted representative per eligible legal joint action against a fresh engine execution. The cache admits only specified HP-independent attacks, no active healing items or initial damage-over-time conditions, and strictly surviving translated outcomes. States keep their exact HP. Read-only audit results measure reuse potential in this workload, not whole-kernel equivalence, search speedup, stronger policy guarantees or deployment strength. Unit tests separately cover exhaustive probability kernels and rejected KO/healing/HP-sensitive boundaries.
